records.text: Macklemore said 'free Palestine,' 'free Lebanon,' 'free Cuba,' 'free Congo' and 'free Sudan,' and called ICE a terrorist organization while calling for freedom for people in America living in fear of it.
records.speaker: Macklemore

appearances.snippet: So I say free Palestine. I say free Lebanon. I say free Cuba. I say free Congo, free Sudan, free all people in America living in fear over this terrorist organization ICE.
